description: Create shared TypeScript interfaces for Connector system (Task 3.1), DTO domain models with Zod schemas (Task 3.2), and AI module interfaces (Task 3.3) in packages/shared.
steps: Add 'zod' as a dependency in packages/shared/package.json

Create packages/shared/src/connectors/types.ts with interfaces: ConnectorId (branded string type), ConnectionStatus enum (Connected, Disconnected, Error, Token_Expired, Reauth_Required), ConnectorManifest (id, name, description, icon, authMethod, capabilities, rateLimits), ExternalTrack (externalId, connectorId, title, artist, album, duration, coverUrl, isrc, availability, explicit, isLive, genre), ExternalPlaylist (externalId, connectorId, name, owner, trackCount), TokenBundle (accessToken, refreshToken, expiresAt, scope), Page<T> (items, cursor, hasMore, total), ConnectorCtx (userId, connectionId, tokens), PlaybackHandle (streamUrl, format, expiresAt), Lyrics (lines with timestamps)

Create packages/shared/src/connectors/interfaces.ts with MusicConnector interface (full signature: startAuth, handleCallback, refresh, revoke, listPlaylists, listLikedTracks, listRecentlyPlayed, getTrack, getDeepLink, getPlaybackHandle?, getLyrics?) and ConnectorRegistry interface (register, get, list, has)

Create packages/shared/src/dto/models.ts with domain model interfaces: InternalTrack, Album, Artist, Playlist, MatchDecision, ListeningEvent, PlaybackSession, User, PrivacySetting, Recommendation, AIProfile, MoodCluster, SyncJob, Notification, FeatureFlag

Create packages/shared/src/dto/schemas.ts with Zod schemas for all DTOs: internalTrackSchema, albumSchema, artistSchema, playlistSchema, matchDecisionSchema, userSchema, syncJobSchema, notificationSchema, featureFlagSchema, etc.

Create packages/shared/src/dto/envelope.ts with ProblemDetails (RFC 7807 shape: type, title, status, detail, instance, extensions), PageResponse<T> (items, page, perPage, total, hasMore), ApiError class

Create packages/shared/src/ai/interfaces.ts with AIModuleManifest (id, type, capabilities, io, cost, privacyClass), RecoSourceManifest, AnalyticsManifest, and registry interfaces AIModuleRegistry, RecoSourceRegistry, AnalyticsRegistry
Update packages/shared/src/index.ts to re-export everything from connectors/, dto/, ai/ subdirectories
Run pnpm install to install zod, then pnpm run typecheck and pnpm run lint to verify
acceptance_criteria: packages/shared/src/dto/schemas.ts exports Zod validation schemas for key DTOs
packages/shared/src/ai/interfaces.ts exports AI module manifests and registries
pnpm run typecheck passes for all packages including those that depend on @open-music/shared
pnpm run lint passes with no errors
findings: Had to install eslint-import-resolver-typescript as a root devDependency - it was referenced in .eslintrc.cjs settings but missing from package.json. This was a pre-existing gap that only manifested once actual imports existed. All typecheck/lint/build pass. Pre-commit hook (lint-staged) ran prettier+eslint fix on staged files successfully.
